sloka: परिगृह्योदकं शीतं वनानि फलवन्ति च ।बलौघं संविभज्येमं व्यूह्य तिष्ठेम लक्ष्मण ।। ६.४१.११ ।।।।
transliteration: parigṛhyodakaṁ śītaṁ vanāni phalavanti ca ।balaughaṁ saṁvibhajyemaṁ vyūhya tiṣṭhema lakṣmaṇa ।। 6.41.11 ।।।।

translations.english: "Lakshmana! We should occupy a region with cool water and good fruits and plan to divide the army and be ready."
